title: zoom - Transforms - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
TRANSFORMS zoom Utilities for scaling elements using zoom. Class Styles zoom- zoom: %; zoom-() zoom: var(); zoom-[] zoom: ; EXAMPLES Basic example Use zoom- utilities like zoom-75 and zoom-125 to scale an element using the CSS zoom property:
Using a custom value Use the zoom-[] syntax to set the zoom based on a completely custom value:
For CSS variables, you can also use the zoom-() syntax:
This is just a shorthand for zoom-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Applying on hover Prefix a zoom utility with a variant like hover:* to only apply the utility in that state:
Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. Responsive design Prefix a zoom utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:
